study type: Cohort study and diagnostic accuracy study
outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of 3D ultrasound for intrauterine adhesions (IUA)
Diagnostic accuracy of 2D ultrasound for IUA
Pregnancy outcome (natural fertilization, mature delivery, cesarean delivery, spontaneous abortion)
cohort: The study included 102 puerperas diagnosed with intrauterine adhesions.
finding: Intrauterine 3-dimensional ultrasound showed significantly higher overall accuracy, especially for mild intrauterine adhesions, compared to 2-dimensional ultrasound, and 76.47% of patients achieved natural fertilization after hysteroscopic surgery with subsequent pregnancies resulting in mature delivery, cesarean delivery, or spontaneous abortion.
mod_finding: Among the patients who became pregnant after treatment, 45 cases resulted in cesarean delivery, 24 in mature delivery, and 9 in spontaneous abortion.
